extraction.notes: Starting line is the reconciliation's 'Net loss' of $(4,667), which differs from the summary table's net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(4,653); the reconciliation figure was used. The Pandemic expense row is garbled in the source ('(1) | 3 | 24 | N/M'): '(1)' is a footnote marker; the Q1 2022 amount is 3 and the 24 belongs to Q1 2021. This is confirmed because the Core FFO total of 20,091 only foots with 3. Diluted shares 25,620 reproduce FFO $0.74, Core FFO $0.78 and AFFO $0.87. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so the quarterly recurring capex of 2,043 from the Historical Capital Expenditures table (page 17) is recorded.
